rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DICuptight
Exhibition name: Tintinara ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, 1996).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses as 'Tintinara'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, geranium-red reverse. Poppy red. Mild, green apple fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Large, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 41" (80 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.

rows.Notes:
Fryer's Roses says Tintinara has large, moderately full, bright poppy red flowers. This rose is a Gold Medal winner...
One of the roses (listed as 'Tintinara') in the Rose Introducers of New Zealand (RINZ) 1998 Display Trial.
